QuestInfo.name: [Henesys Ruins] Gathering Food
QuestInfo.0: Supposedly, Empress Cygnus and the Knights became corrupted, and drove Henesys to ruin. Maybe there's been a misunderstanding. Listen to what the townspeople have to say. Particularly #bCamila#k; she seems to need help.
QuestInfo.1:
The Cygnus Knights' attacks have left Henesys short on food. Help Camila gather ingredients for the people. 

Defeat #bMutant Orange Mushrooms#k in #b#m271020100##k or #b#m271020000##k and get #bMutant Mushroom Cap x40#k.
QuestInfo.2: You brought food to the people of Henesys. Camila reminded you of Mrs. Ming Ming, who cares for the townspeople in the present.

0.0: Oh, you're the outsider! The chief told us about you. Is it true you're going around, helping people out?

yes.0: We can't farm, and we can't hunt, because the Cygnus Knights control the regions outside of town. Could you help us gather some food before we starve?
yes.1: The #bMutant Orange Mushrooms#k that inhabit the #bDark Spore Hill#k and #bCreepy Humming Forest Trail#k are pretty nutritious.\r\nPlease defeat some #bMutant Orange Mushrooms#k, and bring me about #b40#k #bMutant Mushroom Caps#k.

no.0: Huh. But if you're not... then who...?

1.0: Did you get all the Mushroom Caps?

yes.0: Thank you very much. I'll start cooking right away!

item.0: To make enough food for everyone, I need about #b40#k #bMutant Mushroom Caps#k.
